title: 800V DC Data Center Power Architecture
question: Has 800V DC power architecture moved from proposal to independently attributable field deployment?
answer: One attributable operator record supports one commercial SST-to-800VDC deployment; independent validation, replication, and industry adoption remain unresolved.

evidence.title: 800V DC Data Center Power Architecture: Field Deployment Evidence
evidence.supports: One named operator reported commercial operation at one named campus for a materially relevant 10kV AC to SST to 800VDC architecture.
evidence.does_not_establish: Independent performance validation. Long operating history. Multi-entity replication. Application qualification. Repeat procurement. Industry adoption. Full PDRE validation.

counter_evidence.title: Vertiv practical path to 800 VDC
counter_evidence.reason: Future commercialization and pilots do not establish field operation.

counter_evidence.title: Siemens and Reinhausen DC power solutions
counter_evidence.reason: Development for future deployment does not establish field operation.

search_provenance.boundary: One narrow L1 field-deployment verification; no general 800V research was authorized.

history.why: Human review accepted one attributable operator record for one named commercial deployment.
